name: Magistrate Solomon
summary: Lakeshire looks to Magistrate Solomon as gnolls and orcs close in. From the town hall, he governs local affairs and pleads with Stormwind for military aid, but the capital is distracted and gives no help.

sections.title: A Town Under Siege
sections.body: Magistrate Solomon governs Lakeshire as danger closes around the town. Redridge and Shadowhide gnolls prowl the surrounding hills, while Blackrock orcs descend from the north in organized warbands. Solomon and Marshal Marris work to keep order and muster a defense, but Lakeshire's guards and militia are stretched to their limit.

sections.title: Appeals to Deaf Ears
sections.body: Magistrate Solomon has sent messengers across the kingdom, pleading for aid from Westfall, Darkshire, and Stormwind. The replies bring little hope. Westfall struggles under the Defias Brotherhood, Duskwood faces its own creeping terrors, and Stormwind City refuses to send troops to the eastern frontier. Lakeshire is left to defend itself.

sections.title: The Court's Refusal
sections.body: Magistrate Solomon sends a warning to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon when evidence links the Blackrock orcs to the black dragonflight. Royal advisor Lady Katrana Prestor dismisses Solomon's pleas as wild exaggeration. Guided by her counsel and limited by Stormwind's thinly spread forces, Bolvar refuses to commit the Stormwind Army and gives Solomon royal sanction to deputize independent mercenaries.

faq.answer: Magistrate Solomon leads Lakeshire's civil affairs and presides over the Court of Lakeshire. From the town hall, he oversees the town's administration and organizes its defense against gnolls and orcs.

faq.q: Why can't Stormwind send troops to help him?
faq.answer: Stormwind's military is already stretched thin across several troubled regions. When Solomon appeals for aid, Highlord Bolvar Fordragon is influenced by royal advisor Lady Katrana Prestor, who questions Solomon's reports and discourages sending regular troops to Redridge.

faq.q: Did Ironforge try to send help?
faq.answer: Yes. At Solomon's plea, King Magni Bronzebeard sent a relief contingent led by Princess Moira Bronzebeard. The expedition never reached Redridge; it was ambushed and captured in the Burning Steppes.
Lakeshire faces Redridge and Shadowhide gnolls in its hills and on its roads, along with Blackrock orcs raiding south from Stonewatch Keep and the Burning Steppes.

faq.q: Who works with Solomon to defend the town?
faq.answer: Solomon works chiefly with Marshal Marris, who directs the local town guard. With no regular reinforcements, the two officials enlist and deputize traveling adventurers to push back the threats.

faq.q: Why does Solomon send couriers to Darkshire and Westfall?
faq.answer: Solomon sends couriers to Darkshire and Westfall in hopes of forming mutual aid pacts with nearby Alliance settlements. Westfall is held in the grip of the Defias Brotherhood, while Duskwood is overwhelmed by undead and feral beasts; neither can spare a defender.

angles.text: Solomon's abandonment reveals deep fractures within the Alliance of Stormwind, leaving its outer provinces to rely on freelance heroes.
As a human traveler, you can hear from Solomon how grim the kingdom's condition is beyond Elwynn Forest's inner borders.
As a dwarf, you may see a tragic link to Ironforge's effort to answer Solomon's distress call: the expedition was ambushed, and Princess Moira Bronzebeard was captured.
